subject: SIG follow-up: sample audit-log export + retention mapping for Nimbus
messages:
From: Elaine Barnes <elaine.barnes@audits.example.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@nimbusfinancial.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up: sample audit logs + retention mapping for Nimbus Financial

Alex / Marissa —

Thanks again for taking our SIG. Nimbus has a couple of follow-up asks from their internal risk reviewers: they want a small sample set of tenant-level audit events (not production PII) covering the last 90 days, plus a concise mapping that shows which events are retained, for how long, and where the logs are stored (S3 bucket path / object lifecycle). They also want confirmation of the mechanism by which an authorized customer can retrieve their own tenant logs (pre-signed URL, console export, API endpoint) and any RBAC controls applied.

Can you provide:
- A CSV sample (anonymized) with ~1k events for a single tenant, with a short README describing fields
- A one-page retention mapping PDF (event category -> retention period -> storage location)
- Instructions or sample command for how Nimbus would request and receive their audit export (preferably a reproducible presigned URL flow)

Requested timeline: Nimbus would like the artifacts by EOD 10 Feb if possible. If that’s tight, please suggest a realistic delivery ETA.

Attachments: none (this is an evidence request)

Best,
Elaine Barnes
Sr. Auditor, Audits Inc.
elaine.barnes@audits.example.com
+1 415-555-0132
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: sample audit logs + retention mapping for Nimbus Financial

Marissa —

Forwarding Elaine’s request from Audits Inc. Nimbus needs: anonymized tenant event CSV (~1k rows), one-page retention mapping, and presigned URL example + RBAC explanation. Requested by EOD tomorrow (10 Feb). Can we produce a sanitized sample from the tenant export pipeline and a short PDF that maps our event categories + S3 lifecycle rules? Please include:
- Which fields are redacted/replaced for samples (we should state exact columns removed)
- Exact S3 path patterns and lifecycle rules (bucket names can be redacted but show structure)
- Method for generating a presigned GET (lifetime, who can request it — token-level / role)

Karthik — looping you in to confirm this delivery is fine from a sales/contract perspective; Nimbus asked in the SIG about retention SLAs and whether we can provide a one-off export without requiring an enterprise export contract. If procurement asks, we should be ready to quote any one-time fee.

I can package the final response to Elaine once we have the artifacts. ETA?

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 13:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: sample audit logs + retention mapping for Nimbus Financial

Alex / Karthik —

We can deliver the artifacts by EOD 10 Feb. Summary of what I’ll attach:

1) sample-tenant-logs-2026Q4.csv (anonymized, ~1k rows) — columns: timestamp, tenant_id (hashed), event_type, resource_type, actor_role, outcome, request_id, request_path. Fields removed: user_email, ip_address, full_request_payload.

2) retention-mapping-202702.pdf — single-page mapping that lists event categories (auth, usage, system, admin), default retention (auth: 365d, usage: 90d, system: 730d, admin: 365d), and storage location pattern: s3://rwi-audit-logs/{region}/{tenant}/{year}/{month}/events.avro. Note: we’ll redact the actual bucket name for public docs but provide exact bucket to Nimbus via a presigned flow.

3) s3-presigned-links.txt — an example CLI snippet and guidance for generating time-limited presigned GETs (we’ll include typical expiry values we use: 1h for support exports, 24h max for customer-requested packages) and RBAC note: only service accounts with role rwi:exporter or owner of the tenant (via a validated support ticket) can request exports.

I will prepare the CSV and PDF and upload them to an internal evidence Drive folder, then produce presigned links for delivery. I’ll also include a short README with the anonymization rules.

Attachments: sample manifest (will attach when ready)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Platform Security Operations
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Barnes <elaine.barnes@audits.example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@nimbusfinancial.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 15:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: sample audit logs + retention mapping for Nimbus Financial

Elaine / Tom —

Thanks for the patience — attached are the artifacts requested in your SIG follow-up. Summary below and quick notes on scope.

Attachments (delivered):
- sample-tenant-logs-2026Q4.csv (anonymized sample, ~1k rows)
- retention-mapping-202702.pdf (one-page mapping of event categories -> retention -> storage pattern)
- s3-presigned-links.txt (CLI + example presigned URL pattern)

What we delivered:
- The CSV is sanitized: user-identifying columns removed, tenant_id hashed, IPs removed. Schema and README included as the first rows.
- The retention mapping describes default retention windows and lifecycle transitions to Glacier; exact bucket names are shared via the presigned workflow for customer data and in the attached s3-presigned-links.txt.
- Export mechanism: we issue a presigned GET for the requested tenant package. The presigned URL is created by a service account with rwi:exporter scope after a recorded support authorization. Presigned URLs expire after the configured TTL (we used 24h for the sample).

Notes / caveats:
- If Nimbus wants exports on a schedule (automated deliveries), we need to agree contractually on job frequency and retention SLAs.
- If they require unredacted event payloads, we require a signed DPA + egress controls.

Links / evidence:
- Internal evidence folder (redacted link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSIG-evidence
- HubSpot record for this request: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/record/NF-8342

If you’d like, we can run a short walkthrough (15–20 min) of the sample and the presigned URL flow. Please let me know a few times that work.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
Attachments:
- sample-tenant-logs-2026Q4.csv (CSV, 1.1MB)
- retention-mapping-202702.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
- s3-presigned-links.txt (TXT, 2KB)
